race.comment: INOUE (1) settled back in the field before making up a stack of ground to score with a fair bit in hand first-up over this course and distance last start. Given a five-week freshen up since that success. Second-up form reads two wins and a second from three tries. Goes up 3kgs but McDonald rides so a repeat performance in a similar race is on the cards. SHALAA GOLD (7) led and was brave but found one better when resuming over 1000m at Kembla last time out. Has a strong second-up record and likes racing here over today's trip. Big threat with Tim Clark taking over. ZALE (3) led but could not withstand the finish of INOUE here at his latest appearance. Genuine sprinter who will go forward and give a great sight as always. BREMEL (2) is back from a seven-month spell. Lightly raced mare who usually needs a run but cannot be underestimated. MISS TRENTINO (5) won three on the bounce before spelling, the last victory over the smart Miss Freelove the highlight. Trialling in great style.
